stapler-mcp._supersedes: read-website-fast, website-downloader, docs-mcp-server -- one shared native daemon (thin stdio client per session) instead of a fresh npx/uvx process tree per subagent. Requires `cargo install --path crates/cli` from the stapler-mcp repo so `stapler-mcp` resolves on PATH; BRAVE_API_KEY must also be set for brave_web_search since the daemon inherits it from whichever thin client first spawns it.

1password._requires: 1Password desktop app installed natively (not Flatpak/Snap) with Settings > Developer > 'Integrate with MCP clients' turned on. after-install.sh symlinks the binary to /usr/local/bin. Fails to start (command not found) on machines without the app — same graceful-failure pattern as brave-search needing BRAVE_API_KEY.
